quote: Interestingly, compared with Z0, this study showed that 13 putative structural genes related to the flavonoid pathway were up-regulated in Z1, indicating that these putative genes may be the key target genes regulating flavonoid biosynthesis and metabolism.
note: Measured S. oblata; no plant-sensing carry to queued S. vulgaris. This records a light-dependent metabolic response and does not identify a sensory receptor.
